sources.title: veyra-ai (Veyra AI) - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Veyra AI focuses on CPU-friendly inference, function calling, tool use, Python-oriented small models, distillation, RLVR, and lightweight fine-tuning. The goal is to make compact models that are easy to run, inspect, adapt, and use in real workflows without large hardware.

sources.snippet: Veyra — marketing site Real-time AI voice translation that preserves meaning, tone, and human emotion. This is the full cinematic marketing site: a custom Three.js neural-communication-network hero, scroll-choreographed storytelling sections, an interactive translation demo, and a horizontal-scroll applications gallery.

sources.title: Veyra-AI/PROJECT.md at main · atrx07/Veyra-AI · GitHub
sources.snippet: Veyra is an offline, text-based virtual assistant built with Python fundamentals. It responds to a small set of user intents through explicit rule-based logic and demonstrates introductory AI, ML, and DL vocabulary without using trained models.

sources.title: Veyra — Two AIs. One window.
sources.snippet: Two AIs. One window. A tiling terminal manager for AI coding agents. Run Claude Code, Codex CLI, and shells side-by-side in tiled panes. Pro cuts your token usage by roughly 30-50% with output trimming, smart caching, and six task modes.
